name: Gobernación de Caldas
body: Every image read has alt text, every page has a title and a description, and unknown paths answer 404. But robots.txt sends crawlers to /sitemap.xml, and that address answers 404.
lesson: Publish the sitemap at the address robots.txt names, or fix the Sitemap: line to point at the real file.
summary: caldas.gov.co scores 72 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 13 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 18 pages read. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 2 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/canales-de-atencion/pida-una-cita answered 404, linked from /, /transparencia and 4 more. /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/tramites-y-otros-procedimientos-administrativos/encuesta-de-satisfaccion answered 404, linked…
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/informacion-de-interes/informe-de-peticiones, /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/tramites-y-otros-procedimientos-administrativos/tramites-otros-procedimientos-administrativos. Screen readers announce them as an…
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 18 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 18 pages read.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
